topic.title: Conversation History Preferences
topic.shortdesc: Configure how the title and the description of each conversation are generated in the chat history.

body.p: The Conversation History preferences page is available in Options Preferences Plugins Oxygen AI Positron Conversation History . It contains the following options:

dlentry.dt: Automatically generate conversation title and description using AI

dd.p: When this option is selected (the default), the AI generates (in the background) the title and description used to identify a conversation in the chat history. The AI generates them from the first message you send, in the same language as that message. A title contains no more than 50 characters.
For a conversation that you start by running an action, the title and description are generated from the action and the content on which it was run.

Until the AI returns the title and description, the conversation is listed using its first message. If this option is not selected, the first message is used as both the title and description. You can rename a conversation at any time from the chat history.

dlentry.dd: Specifies the AI model used to generate titles and descriptions. This option is available only when the Automatically generate conversation title and description using AI option is selected. The drop-down list contains models from all enabled connections, including AI Positron Service models when the service is enabled. If no model is selected, or if the selected model is no longer available, the model currently used by the chat is used.
